svg.title: LayerFS v2.0.0 vs ovnfs: storage and speed on four small history shapes
svg.desc: Six column charts comparing LayerFS and ovnfs per case S1 to S4; values are listed in README.md.
svg.text: LayerFS v2.0.0 (Docker) vs ovnfs — fs-storage-history base tree
Lower is better in every panel. S1 = 1 branch × 40 commits, S2 = 5 branches × 3, S3 = 4 nested forks × 3, S4 = 5 identical branches × 1.
History added per commit (incl. new branches)
Read the whole tree in a fresh view, median
Storage: LayerFS = SQLite file + WAL; ovnfs = state directory, allocated bytes (ext4). Per commit: LayerFS Σ new_stored; ovnfs apparent growth.
Timings: warm, one sample, Docker shared with other sessions (1-min load 13–27) — diagnostic only. 2026-11-06, LayerFS b4fa173e40, ovnfs cdb3fb6.
